entities.name: Pamela Begič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pamela Begič is a Slovenian former footballer who played as a midfielder for Spanish Primera División club Sporting de Huelva. She played for the Slovenia women's national football team from 2011, including during UEFA Women's Euro 2013 qualifying and UEFA Women's Euro 2017 qualifying.
